annotations.title: Send a test email from a brand's mailbox

description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Sends one test email from the brand's connected mailbox to your own account address. It never falls back to flayr's sender, so `sent: true` proves the mailbox works; otherwise `reason` says why (for example cap_reached or disconnected).
(Wraps POST /api/v2/brands/{id}/mailbox/test.)

id.description: A brand id from GET /api/v2/brands. A brand-bound key may only name its own brand (another brand → 403).

name: brand_mailbox_send_test
title: Send a test email from a brand's mailbox
